capture: Chromium PNG, scale 2, default GL backend, 3 workers per composition
reference: ProRes 4444, VideoToolbox where available, decoded yuva444p12le, BT.709 matrix, 1/90000 timebase
delivery: libx265 medium CRF 17; hvc1; yuv420p10le; explicit limited-range BT.709 matrix, transfer and primaries
reproducibility: Frozen code, media, fonts, cue data and analysis inputs. No fresh model inference needed for rendering. Encoder and OS changes may change bitstreams even with the same visual and timing contract.
sampleAspect: Explicit square pixels (1:1). Initial production encodes were losslessly updated with hevc_metadata after metadata QA detected omission; complete decoded video bytes were SHA-256 compared before/after. Future renders declare setsar=1 before encoding.
